speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The recent attack that affected Internet access for some users is a timely reminder that these threats are real and everyone has a part to play to secure our cyberspace.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: For example, through the Readiness Maturity Index (RMI) programme, CSA engages sector leads and operators to review the current level of preparedness, identify areas of improvement and take steps to beef up their defences.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: CSA also conducts regular exercises to validate and test the readiness of these plans.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: CSA works closely with the Info-communications Media Development Authority (IMDA), as the sector lead for the infocomm sector.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: CSA and IMDA place strong emphasis on the cyber resilience of our telecommunications infrastructure as it is a crucial enabler for other sectors.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: This Code requires ISPs to put in place various controls related to prevention, detection and response to cyber-attacks across telecommunications networks.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: The ISPs are also required to engage IMDA-approved auditors to audit their compliance with the Code.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: To improve responses to cyber threats in the infocomm sector, the then-IDA also formed the Infocommunications Singapore Computer Emergency Response Team (ISG-CERT) last year.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Its remit has since been expanded to include the media sector with the formation of IMDA.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: ISG-CERT shares information through the issuance of actionable intelligence and alerts to the telecommunications and media operators to enhance their readiness.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: However, Madam, the cyber threat landscape facing our CIIs is rapidly evolving and attacks are becoming more sophisticated.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Despite our best efforts, breaches cannot be eliminated entirely.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: It is important that we respond swiftly when attacked and bring services back to normalcy as soon as possible.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: We will also need to continually adapt our plans based on lessons learnt.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: While investigations are ongoing for the recent attack, IMDA, CSA and ISPs have not stood still.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Beyond the critical sectors, it is also important that companies, including small and medium enterprises, adopt good cyber security practices.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Consumers expect that digital processes are secured and their private information is protected when transacting with companies.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Businesses should, therefore, view cyber security as investments to improve their competitiveness, rather than just additional cost.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: To keep informed of latest cybersecurity threats and steps to take to mitigate these risks, companies can refer to regular advisories and alerts that are issued by the Singapore Computer Emergency Response Team (SingCERT).

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: As shown by the recent incident, consumers also play an important role in building a safer cyberspace.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Consumers should adopt good cyber hygiene to minimise the risk of falling prey to cybercriminals or unwittingly allow their Internet-connected devices, such as webcams and routers, to be used to launch cyberattacks against others.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Each of us can take responsibility by taking steps, such as changing the default password on home equipment and wireless networks, and regularly applying software updates to our computers and mobile phones.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: Such measures are published regularly on SingCERT's website.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: One, I note that we have done quite a fair bit for the essential services.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: Of course, there is a need to level up the individuals and consumers, including companies' capabilities to deal with the attacks.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: On the second question as to whether or not we will conduct exercises with the consumers, currently, what is being done, as the way we have organised the space, is that we have 11 critical sectors.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: CSA works with the sector leads and the various members of the sectors, be it finance, telecomms, water or energy, to do table-top exercises.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: At the same time, what we do is that we send out advisories and we inform through our website, what are the things that not only businesses, but also consumers can do.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: I agree with the Member that there is a need for us to step up cyber hygiene, especially for consumers.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: This is something which has to be ongoing.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
text: Certainly, I think a public campaign is something that we have launched and we want to continue to reach out to as many consumers as possible to make sure, as I mentioned in my reply, that they ensure that their passwords are changed regularly and they adopt good cyber hygiene.
